notes: Energy North proposes Project Ares, a 1GW hyperscale off-grid AI data centre campus on Murranji Station (19,150 ha, ~90 ha of data halls) in the Barkly Region, powered by gas, solar and battery infrastructure with water from the Montejinni Limestone Aquifer. NT EPA consultation was open from 8 Jul 2026 following submission of an EPBC referral; ABC (1 Jul 2026) and DCD report the proposal. Status = announced/under federal environmental assessment; 1GW is proposed total IT capacity, not built.
